items.explanationEn: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "At once" means both "simultaneously" and "immediately"; here, simultaneously.

items.explanationEn: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (verb): to limit. Noun: restriction; "restrict access".

items.question: Trong câu "The BSL mainly restricts offering competing products; normal internal use is unaffected.", từ "unaffected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BSL mainly restricts offering competing products; normal internal use is unaffected.", what does "unaffected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unaffected /ˌʌn.əˈfek.tɪd/ (tính từ): không bị ảnh hưởng. Cụm: "unaffected by X" = không bị X ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: unaffected /ˌʌn.əˈfek.tɪd/ (adjective): not influenced. Pattern: "unaffected by X".

items.question: Trong câu "IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp in 2025.", từ "acquisition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp in 2025.", what does "acquisition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: acquisition /ˌæk.wɪˈzɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): thương vụ mua lại. Động từ: acquire; "data acquisition" = thu thập dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: acquisition /ˌæk.wɪˈzɪʃ.ən/ (noun): buying another company. Verb: acquire; "data acquisition" means collecting data.

items.question: Trong câu "Inside the machine → Ansible, ideally at image-build time.", từ "ideally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inside the machine → Ansible, ideally at image-build time.", what does "ideally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ideally /aɪˈdɪə.li/ (trạng từ): lý tưởng nhất là. Dùng để nêu cách tốt nhất nhưng không bắt buộc.
items.explanationEn: ideally /aɪˈdɪə.li/ (adverb): in the best case. Used to name the best, though optional, way.

items.question: Trong câu "IaC = infrastructure in version-controlled code: reproducible, reviewable, auditable, fast to recover.", từ "reproducible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "IaC = infrastructure in version-controlled code: reproducible, reviewable, auditable, fast to recover.", what does "reproducible" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be recreated the same
items.explanation: reproducible /ˌriː.prəˈdjuː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): tái tạo được như cũ. "Reproducible build" = build lại cho ra kết quả giống hệt; động từ: reproduce.
items.explanationEn: reproducible /ˌriː.prəˈdjuː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be recreated the same. "Reproducible build" gives identical output; verb: reproduce.

items.question: Trong câu "IaC = infrastructure in version-controlled code: reproducible, reviewable, auditable, fast to recover.", từ "auditable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "IaC = infrastructure in version-controlled code: reproducible, reviewable, auditable, fast to recover.", what does "auditable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be checked and traced
items.explanation: auditable /ˈɔː.dɪ.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): kiểm toán/truy vết được. Danh từ: audit (kiểm toán); "audit trail" = dấu vết kiểm toán.
items.explanationEn: auditable /ˈɔː.dɪ.tə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked and traced. Noun: audit; "audit trail".

items.question: Trong câu "Workspaces are not strong isolation — prod gets its own account and state.", từ "isolation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workspaces are not strong isolation — prod gets its own account and state.", what does "isolation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: isolation /ˌaɪ.səlˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cô lập, tách biệt. Động từ: isolate; "tenant isolation" = cô lập giữa các khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: isolation /ˌaɪ.səlˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): keeping things separate. Verb: isolate; "tenant isolation".

items.question: Trong câu "Ansible configures machines; CloudFormation/CDK trade portability for managed state and rollback.", từ "trade for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ansible configures machines; CloudFormation/CDK trade portability for managed state and rollback.", what does "trade for" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to give up in exchange for
items.explanation: trade for /ˈtreɪd fɔːr/ (cụm từ): đánh đổi lấy. "Trade X for Y" = hy sinh X để có Y; liên quan: trade-off (sự đánh đổi).
items.explanationEn: trade for /ˈtreɪd fɔːr/ (phrase): to give up in exchange for. "Trade X for Y" = give up X to get Y; related: trade-off.

items.question: Trong câu "Ansible configures machines; CloudFormation/CDK trade portability for managed state and rollback.", từ "portability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ansible configures machines; CloudFormation/CDK trade portability for managed state and rollback.", what does "portability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: portability /ˌpɔː.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng chuyển nền tảng. Tính từ: portable; tránh "vendor lock-in" nhờ portability.
items.explanationEn: portability /ˌpɔː.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ability to move across platforms. Adjective: portable; portability avoids vendor lock-in.
